original.statement: A new cert-manager controller flag --extra-certificate-annotations was added, letting operators specify annotation keys to copy from Ingress or Gateway resources to the resulting Certificate.

decision.reason: [ev-da53ded48367] says "We've added a new configuration option to the cert-manager controller: `--extra-certificate-annotations`". The leading dashes make it a CLI flag, the text names the controller as the component that owns it, and "added" is the right change type. The render validators were inconclusive because the flag doesn't show up with the chart defaults, so nothing in the artifacts contradicts this.
